root_cause: BackupScheduler retried every failure on RETRY_DELAYS_MS=[30s,2m,10m], including a first attempt that failed only because the relays were still connecting at start-up (NDK connect 2.5 s + kind-30051 relay-list fetch 8 s + publish 2.5 s = ~13 s to fail); the retry then paid the 8 s relay-list timeout again. A fresh session went ~43 s+ without a backup.
fix: relayBackup.ts: (1) BackupScheduler.coldStart flag: the first failure before the first success is retried after COLD_START_RETRY_MS=5 s, once per scheduler, outside the MAX_RETRIES budget; the regular schedule follows unchanged; any success clears the flag. (2) getBackupRelays(ndk, pubkey, {reuseAfterRecentTimeout}) — used by publishBackup only: an in-memory per-pubkey record of the last relay-list timeout; within RELAY_LIST_TIMEOUT_REUSE_MS=60 s of a timeout it skips the fetch and uses the currently configured relays (getEffectiveRelays() read at call time; no remembered list). List extraction moved into relayUrlsFromNewestList (behaviour identical). resetBackupRelayListMemo() exported for tests. Indeterminate publish (timeout) keeps current semantics: failure -> retried; documented at the retry branch.
deviations_from_design: Success signal 'within 15 s' is met except when relays stay unresponsive for the whole ~13 s first attempt: then the backup lands at ~18 s (was ~43 s+). Strict 15 s would need shorter backup-path timeouts (open question).
tests_added: tests/unit/backup/coldStartRetry.test.ts (new, 21 tests, fake timers, no jsdom). Scheduler: early retry at 5 s (boundary), regular 30 s/2 min/10 min x3 after it (7 calls total), rejected first attempt, success path unchanged (later failure waits 30 s), granted once, change during the wait rides along, dispose cancels. Memo (as of round 1, see remediation_round_1): 60 s boundary, complete fetch clears the timeout (lookup path always fetches), timed-out partial list not memoised, per identity, publishBackup uses it. Composed (real BackupScheduler + publishScheduledBackup + publishBackup, NDK/signer/idb mocked): connect failure -> lands 5 s after; relay-list timeout + publish timeout -> retry skips the fetch, lands at 18 s; retry after a timeout reuses the earlier complete list; publish timeout (indeterminate) retried like a refusal; outright refusal retried; healthy start publishes once; long outage -> 5 s then 30 s.
tests/unit/backup/relayBackup.test.ts: 4 AC-BRR-9/10 schedule tests updated to the 5 s first retry; resetBackupRelayListMemo in beforeEach.
